content:
opsbot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — billing-metering anomaly. Token counts spike from emitter-frontend-1 starting ~1715009500, ingestion latency increasing, several customers hit overage flags. Auto-throttle unhelpful. Investigating root cause.

maya_oncall: I'm looking into the ingestion pipeline now, seen spikes on the emitter side and a backlog in kafka-consumers. pinging @sam_sre and @jennie_billing.

sam_sre: oncall here, pulling consumer lag metrics. consumer_group:metering-ingest shows lag ~1.2M messages, partition skewed to p-3. Any recent deploys to emitter-frontend-1?

maya_oncall: no deploys in last hour. edge logs show a retry storm from a subset of clients — many 429s then retries. suspect duplicate emission + slow consumers.

jennie_billing: if duplicates are landing in the aggregation window we can see count inflation and overage flags. Can we enable short-term dedupe at the aggregator before full recon?

liam_eng_platform: we have a quick feature flag to enable idempotent-dedupe for realtime pipeline. Commands: 
```
# flip the flag for staging path only (will affect realtime path)
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADM' \ 
  https://flags.internal/flip -d '{"flag":"metering_realtime_dedupe","env":"prod","value":true}'
```
I can flip it in 2 mins after approval.

maya_oncall: do it. we need to stop fresh duplicates, even if it delays some low-priority events.

liam_eng_platform: flipping now. Confirming rollout to emitter-frontend-1 and aggregator-workers. :white_check_mark:

opsbot: system: feature-flag "metering_realtime_dedupe" set to true for prod path (rollout 100%) by liam_eng_platform.

sam_sre: consumer lag trending down after flag — looks like dedupe reduced duplicate volume by ~68%. still seeing delayed batches though because of sustained backlog.

jennie_billing: start a targeted reconciliation for windows 1715009000-1715009800 to scrub suspected duplicates and re-evaluate billing flags. I'll open a ticket to accounting.

rachel_support: prepping customer comms. Which tenants are most affected?

maya_oncall: top 10 by alerts: tenant-a, tenant-f, tenant-k, tenant-x... sending list to #support-ops DM. Immediate action: temporary suppression of automated overage emails for suspected window to avoid false alarms. Rachel please hold send until we confirm.

rachel_support: acknowledged. Holding notifications, will prepare a note saying "we're investigating anomalous usage reporting; no action required yet".

sam_sre: preliminary root cause hypothesis: upstream proxy returned intermittent 502s causing clients to retry aggressively; retries lacked jitter and dedupe tokens, causing duplicate tokens to be emitted. Then slow consumer backlog amplified counts. Fix path: short-term dedupe (done), increase consumer parallelism for partition p-3, and long-term: enforce idempotency token at emitter.

maya_oncall: increasing consumer parallelism on p-3 by +2 replicas now (scaling command issued).

opsbot: deploy-bot: autoscaler increased metering-consumer replicas from 6 -> 8 for partition p-3.

liam_eng_platform: starting a controlled replay / recon job to reconcile counts; will mark reconciled tokens as "deduped" in the billing pipeline and clear overage flags for customers with negative reconciliation delta. ETA ~45m.

jennie_billing: noted. I'll coordinate with accounting to ensure we don't bill during the reconciliation window and prepare credits if needed.

maya_oncall: summary for now: 1) dedupe flag enabled (stopped fresh duplicates), 2) consumer scale up happening, 3) reconciliation job running, 4) hold on customer overage emails. No known data loss.

rachel_support: drafting customer status update and support playbook. ping me when recon job finishes so I can release the communication.

sam_sre: lag back to healthy levels, duplicate volume down, reconciliation job started and processing.

liam_eng_platform: recon job finished. Applied dedupe corrections, adjusted billing window, cleared 78 overage flags (confirmed via runbook). Posting reconciliation artifact to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/recon/1715009876/recon-summary.csv

jennie_billing: verified reconciled counts against expected, no billing should be applied for inflated tokens in window. I'll close the accounting ticket after manual audit.

maya_oncall: marking incident as mitigated. Will run a postmortem and follow-ups: enforce idempotency tokens at edge, improve retry jitter guidance, add consumer partition rebalancing alert, and add a playbook step to suppress overage emails when ingestion anomalies are detected.

opsbot: incident closed (mitigated) by maya_oncall. Severity: P2. Follow-up: PM for postmortem assigned to maya_oncall and jennie_billing.

rachel_support: thanks team. I'll send the delayed customer comms now with a note about reconciliation and credits where applicable. :tada:
